functions.description: Store a registered event callback by its DOM event name. Inputs: name is the event string and callback is the handler. Returns undefined; the Map retains one callback per name, sufficient for the viewer's single handlers rather than full DOM event semantics.

functions.name: fakeBrowser.dispatch
functions.description: Dispatch a control event with this element as its target. Input: name selects a registered handler. Returns undefined; optional chaining makes absent handlers a no-op. Registered callbacks run synchronously with a minimal event target object.

functions.name: fakeBrowser.setAttribute
functions.description: Record ARIA and other attributes for deterministic assertions. Inputs: name/value are attribute data. Returns undefined; coerces value to String and stores it, without implementing DOM validation or accessibility-tree updates.

functions.name: fakeBrowser.replaceWith
functions.description: Atomically replace the displayed image node with the successfully loaded candidate. Input: node is the loaded fake candidate with its frame ID. Returns undefined; overwrites the latest node Map entry so subsequent getElementById/assertions see the committed image.

functions.name: fakeBrowser.constructor
functions.description: Register each requested image so tests can choose callback completion order. Inputs: none. Constructor calls Element initialization then appends this Image to images. Assigning src does not auto-load; tests call load/fail explicitly to reproduce stale asynchronous completions.

functions.name: fakeBrowser.load
functions.description: Trigger the image load callback at a controlled point. Inputs: none. Returns undefined; invokes onload only if set, synchronously. Tests can load older candidates after newer ones without involving file I/O.

functions.name: fakeBrowser.fail
functions.description: Trigger the image error callback at a controlled point. Inputs: none. Returns undefined; invokes onerror only if set, allowing deterministic missing-image and late-failure behavior.

functions.name: fakeBrowser.matchMedia
functions.description: Return the configured reduced-motion preference. Inputs: query arguments are ignored by this stand-in. Returns an object with matches equal to reducedMotion; it neither observes system preferences nor dispatches preference changes.

functions.name: fakeBrowser.getElementById
functions.description: Resolve the latest node, including any atomically replaced image. Input: id is a viewer element name. Returns its current Map value or undefined; no nodes are created by lookup.

functions.name: imageAlignment
functions.description: Verify autoplay and prevent asynchronous older images from replacing a newer seek. Inputs: none. Returns undefined if assertions pass. It starts autoplay, seeks to 450, loads that image/state, then completes the obsolete first image and requires no replacement. Pausing at end clears the fake scheduling chain.

functions.name: imageFailure
functions.description: Verify missing captures expose an error and never pair a stale screen with newer state. Inputs: none. Returns undefined on success; after loading the first image it seeks to 100, elapses 800 wall ms and fails that image. It requires hidden pixels/empty state/error/paused time exactly 100, then verifies a later successful seek clears the error.

functions.name: shortRecordings
functions.description: Verify empty and one-frame recordings have explicit stationary states. Inputs: none. Returns undefined on success; loops over fresh empty/single fixtures and requires stopped clocks, disabled controls and explanatory messages. It proves the viewer does not schedule meaningless animation for insufficient capture duration.

functions.name: preference
functions.description: Verify motion preference only affects initial state and all controls remain operable. Inputs: none. Returns undefined on success; mounts with reduced motion, dispatches play/speed/seek/loop/replay control events and checks resulting clock state. Preference suppresses autoplay while manual controls continue functioning; final pause cancels fake callbacks.

functions.name: screenSelection
functions.description: Screen selection must reload the same timestamp and ignore an obsolete view completion.

functions.name: screenSelection.<callback@389:32>
functions.description: Give every capture a debug and history view next to its main image.

functions.name: test_journal_read
functions.description: Return a stored slot, or erased for slots never written.

functions.name: test_journal_write
functions.description: Write an erased slot once; occupied slots are refused like the eMMC writer.

functions.name: app_data_log_get_count
functions.description: Return the test-controlled RAM count used by the production debug-screen binding. Inputs: none. Returns test_ram_count without mutation so each test can choose exact usage values independently of the real RAM logger.

functions.name: app_data_log_get_capacity
functions.description: Return the test-controlled RAM capacity, including the zero-capacity boundary. Inputs: none. Returns test_ram_capacity without mutation; zero intentionally exercises the UI division guard.

functions.name: app_emmc_log_get_status
functions.description: Copy the test-controlled eMMC usage counters without performing any device operation. Input: status must be writable. Returns nothing; copies the configured test structure including reserved/written block counters. Unlike production this stub uses no mutex or storage calls.

functions.name: assert_text_at
functions.description: Abort unless label shows exactly expected; prints both texts and the caller's line first.

functions.name: assert_border_color
functions.description: Compare a panel's effective RGB565 border color to LVGL's conversion of a hex color. Inputs: panel is an existing object and expected is a 24-bit RGB hex color. Returns nothing; compares both sides after LVGL RGB565 conversion so precision loss is accounted for. Assertion failure aborts execution.

functions.name: test_auxiliary_unknowns_and_faults
functions.description: Verify explicit unknowns stay visible and replace values left by an earlier sample. Inputs: none; renderer-created objects must exist. Returns nothing or aborts on mismatch. Writes unknown, all-healthy, each single fault and invalid-mode states at tick 4000. It proves group-wide visibility: all healthy hides all seven panels, any unknown/fault shows all, each border reflects its own validity/fault.

functions.name: test_existing_demo
functions.description: Verify demo speed/mode and known-healthy statuses retain their original timing rules. Inputs: none. Returns nothing or aborts; updates one local placeholder state at 0,200,3000,5000,10000 ms. This verifies retained firmware demonstration timing rather than deriving modes/speed from vehicle CAN.

functions.name: test_battery_labels_and_storage_usage
functions.description: Verify signed measurement labels, voltage rounding and usage without uint32 overflow. Inputs: none. Returns nothing or aborts; supplies signed temperature/power extremes, rounded cell millivolts and large usage counters. Test-controlled globals are changed, including zero capacity, to prove safe percentage formatting and the one-header-block subtraction.

functions.name: test_initial_measurements_are_unknown
functions.description: The firmware refreshes once before the first frame, so no SquareLine placeholder text ("120", "N", "0", "BSPB") or measured zero is ever shown, and gauges start hidden.

functions.name: known_battery
functions.description: Return a fully received battery snapshot with every signal stamped at tick.

functions.name: healthy_auxiliary
functions.description: Return wired, valid and healthy auxiliary inputs at 42 km/h in drive.

functions.name: find_event
functions.description: Return the first event at or after index from source, or UINT32_MAX when none exists.

functions.name: test_freshness_and_missing_siblings
functions.description: Per-signal age controls labels and gauges independently, including genuine zero values.

functions.name: test_fault_events_survive_recovery
functions.description: Clearing a live fault appends recovery once the hold time has passed and leaves the raised event intact. Other sources may record their own episodes meanwhile, so the IMD entries are located by source.

functions.name: test_transient_storage_failure_is_retained
functions.description: A write error recovered between GUI refreshes is still one FAULT and, later, one CLEAR.

functions.name: find_button

functions.name: click_button
functions.description: Send CLICKED to the button captioned caption on screen; abort if it does not exist.

functions.name: capture_screen
functions.description: Capture the active screen to <base>.<name>.ppm for later inspection.

functions.name: test_navigation_and_history_pages
functions.description: Exercise the actual touch callbacks, including chronological history pagination.

functions.name: touch_tap
functions.description: Press and release the simulated touch panel, giving LVGL time to read both states.

functions.name: test_touch_navigation
functions.description: Real pointer input reaches the same callbacks as the board's touch panel.

functions.name: test_missing_runtime_screens_are_tolerated
functions.description: Binding tolerates missing runtime screens instead of reaching LVGL's NULL assertion.

functions.name: assert_faults_caption_has_pixels
functions.description: Require white caption pixels where the pack screen's FAULTS button text is drawn.

functions.name: test_repeated_captures_keep_navigation_text
functions.description: A static page must retain identical pixels after repeated off-screen refreshes.

functions.name: test_framebuffer_capture
functions.description: Exercise real partial-buffer rendering, binary PPM size and file-error reporting. Input: output_path is the temporary PPM path chosen by CTest. functions.name: main
functions.description: Run production UI regressions against a memory display and clean up its screen trees. Inputs: exactly one output path argument. Returns zero only after all assertion-based UI/demo/storage/render checks complete. Initializes twice to test idempotence, advances LVGL, captures, shuts down twice and requires capture rejection after teardown. Assertions are kept enabled by the test target.

functions.name: same_event
functions.description: Compare every field of two copied events.

functions.name: lifecycle
functions.description: Recovery and recurrence append records instead of editing or deleting their predecessors.

functions.name: guards_and_source_isolation
functions.description: Each source retains independent state; invalid inputs cannot consume history capacity.

functions.name: overflow_never_overwrites
functions.description: A full RAM-only ledger keeps every existing entry intact and explicitly counts losses.

functions.name: fake_read
functions.description: Return the modeled slot state, copying the event only for valid slots.

functions.name: fake_write
functions.description: Write an erased slot once, recording order; injected failures and occupied slots fail.

functions.name: seed_disk
functions.description: Place a valid event for slot index from an earlier boot.

functions.name: recover_and_append
functions.description: A reboot recovers existing slots and appends in a distinct session without editing them.

functions.name: retry_pending_in_order
functions.description: Failed storage writes retain all pending copies; retry commits them strictly in order.

functions.name: corruption_blocks_overwrite
functions.description: A checksum-valid final record this firmware cannot interpret (wrong sequence, source or state) blocks writes; its slot and everything before it stay as found, new events live in RAM and the unreadable record keeps its place in the count.

functions.name: torn_tail_is_skipped
functions.description: A torn final write (unreadable last slot after a valid one) is skipped, never rewritten.

functions.name: foreign_data_blocks
functions.description: Several unreadable final slots are not a torn write: treat as foreign data and block.

functions.name: failing_read
functions.description: An I/O error while locating the end attaches nothing; a later attempt can still attach.

functions.name: attach_io_error_is_retryable
functions.description: Attach once through a failing reader, then again through a working one.

functions.name: search_read
functions.description: Model search_end valid slots followed by erased ones, counting reads.

functions.name: search_write
functions.description: Accept only the next sequential append.

functions.name: binary_search_attach
functions.description: Attach a journal of end events and check the read count, end position and next append.

functions.name: journal_states
functions.description: Journal state reports why events are or are not being saved, in priority order.

functions.name: full_backend_never_overwrites
functions.description: Capacity exhaustion cannot write outside the journal or reuse an occupied slot. This boot's new events are still listed from RAM (marked not saved) instead of being lost.

functions.name: attach_guards
functions.description: Invalid attachment arguments remain retryable; a live journal cannot be replaced.

functions.name: exhausted_session_blocks_writes
functions.description: Exhausting the session namespace must not silently label new writes as session zero.

functions.description: Run the case named by argv[1] (with an optional numeric argument) in this fresh process.

functions.name: journal_read
functions.description: Return the stored slot, or erased for slots never written.

functions.name: journal_write

functions.name: dump_history
functions.description: Print every recorded event to stderr to explain a failed expectation.

functions.name: boot
functions.description: Attach the RAM journal like the firmware attaches the eMMC journal at boot.

functions.name: bms_replies
functions.description: Mark every BMS signal as just received at now.

functions.name: refresh
functions.description: Run one GUI refresh.

functions.name: event_at
functions.description: Copy event index into event; false when absent.

functions.name: silent_bms
functions.description: BMS never answers for 15 minutes while every request times out: one entry in total.

functions.name: late_bms
functions.description: A BMS that starts replying inside the startup grace leaves no entry at all.

functions.name: bms_outage
functions.description: A 30 s outage is one LOST entry and one CLEAR after the hold, nothing per signal or timeout.

functions.name: pid_missing
functions.description: One PID unanswered: the missing signal once, the timeout episode once, each cleared once.

functions.name: timeouts_then_outage
functions.description: Timeouts during an outage belong to the BMS link entry: a timeout episode that was already open keeps counting only until the link is declared down, and its CLEAR reports that count.

functions.name: signal_stops
functions.description: A signal that stops while its siblings keep updating is reported once as stopped.

functions.name: flapping_status
functions.description: A wired IMD toggling every second for a minute is one FAULT and one CLEAR.

functions.name: unwired_and_wired_inputs
functions.description: Inputs without a provider never reach the history; wired-but-silent ones do, once.

functions.name: rejected_frames
functions.description: Rejected frames for two minutes: one FAULT at the first, one CLEAR after the quiet time.

functions.name: storage_episodes
functions.description: A transient write error, a card outage and telemetry overflow are separate episodes.

functions.name: limits
functions.description: Configured limits record one episode with the value; none are configured by default.

functions.name: no_journal
functions.description: Without a card the journal itself is reported once, in RAM.

functions.name: descriptions
functions.description: Every event kind reads as words on the history screen and in exports.

functions.name: main
functions.description: Run the timeline named by argv[1] in this fresh process.

functions.name: xSemaphoreCreateMutex
functions.description: Return a non-null mutex token; the harness performs all operations sequentially. Inputs: none. Returns constant nonnull token (void*)1 without allocation; it does not create a real FreeRTOS mutex.

functions.name: xSemaphoreTake
functions.description: Accept the synthetic mutex without blocking because the harness has one thread. Inputs: mutex/ticks both ignored, including null and timeout values. Returns pdTRUE unconditionally; no exclusion, scheduler or waiting behavior is tested by this storage harness.

functions.name: xSemaphoreGive
functions.description: Release the synthetic mutex token without maintaining a scheduling state. Input: mutex ignored. Returns pdTRUE unconditionally and changes no synchronization state; production mutex ordering is exercised sequentially only.

functions.name: BSP_MMC_Init
functions.description: Report a successful fake initialization; no physical device is accessed. Input: instance must be zero or assertion aborts. Returns BSP_ERROR_NONE; storage erase is done by main rather than this stub, allowing explicit test setup.

functions.name: BSP_MMC_GetCardInfo
functions.description: Return the configured synthetic card capacity to bound production append operations. Inputs: instance zero and writable info. Returns BSP_ERROR_NONE after publishing card_blocks; instance mismatch aborts. The selected capacity constrains the production logger's reserved region.

functions.name: BSP_MMC_ReadBlocks
functions.description: Copy requested fake blocks into the BSP caller, or return the injected read failure. Inputs: instance zero, writable out and a block/count inside the test card region. Invalid harness ranges assert; injected fail_read returns -1 without copying. Success copies count*512 bytes and returns BSP_ERROR_NONE.

functions.name: BSP_MMC_WriteBlocks
functions.description: Persist requested fake blocks, retaining prior bytes when a targeted write failure occurs. Inputs: instance zero, readable in and an asserted valid region. Returns -1 before copying when header/data-specific failure is enabled, preserving old bytes. Success copies blocks and returns BSP_ERROR_NONE, letting retries be checked against persisted contents.

functions.name: HAL_UART_Transmit
functions.description: Append UART bytes to a bounded capture buffer, or return the injected transmit error. Inputs: bytes/count are binary export content; timeout must be HAL_MAX_DELAY, uart is ignored. Returns HAL_ERROR for injected failure; otherwise bounds are asserted, bytes are appended to wire and wire_count advances. It never writes a physical UART.

functions.name: append_sample
functions.description: Append a sample with recognizable signed and unsigned values for C-to-Python checks. Input: timestamp is milliseconds and also distinguishes the pack-voltage sample. Returns nothing; constructs signed/unsigned boundary-rich telemetry and asserts production append succeeds. Values are chosen for cross-language record decoding rather than hardware simulation.

functions.name: check_header
functions.description: Assert persisted header counters match a mutex-protected logger status snapshot. Inputs: none. Returns nothing or aborts; obtains the production mutex-protected status and compares it to bytes persisted in block 4096. Also checks the logger's retained last timestamp, exposing stale/failed header retries.

functions.name: check_staged_bytes
functions.description: Check that UI storage usage does not add a retained tail to an already counted block. Input: expected is the unallocated staged byte count. Returns nothing or aborts; compares a production status snapshot without altering storage. Already-counted retained-tail bytes must not inflate usage.

functions.name: main
functions.description: Run a requested deterministic logger regression and emit only its binary export to stdout. Input: one scenario name: partial/corrupt/csv/slots/automatic/reset/status/capacity/errors/empty. Returns zero only if all asserted invariants hold. It resets fake blocks, initializes production logger, verifies CRC32, exercises selected append/flush/reset/error paths, then exports captured binary bytes to stdout (CSV mode calls production CSV instead). No failure is suppressed; assertions abort before emitting a successful result.

functions.name: BSP_MMC_GetCardState
functions.description: Host fake card writes complete synchronously.

functions.name: AuxiliaryScenarioTests.scenario
functions.description: Parse one auxiliary object while leaving existing battery defaults intact. Input auxiliary is a JSON-like speed/mode/status object. Return Scenario.from_dict with that object and default battery tracks; validation errors propagate. No file/bus I/O.

functions.name: AuxiliaryScenarioTests.test_missing_auxiliary_is_explicitly_unknown
functions.description: Default only the auxiliary inputs to unknown; retain ten battery defaults. Parse an empty scenario at t=0 seconds; require null speed/mode, seven unknown statuses, and ten battery values equal to synthetic zero. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: AuxiliaryScenarioTests.test_constants_and_independent_statuses
functions.description: Keep synthetic status meanings separate instead of deriving one status from another. Sample at 999 seconds with speed 87.25 km/h, mode D and mixed status constants. Assert no status is inferred from another and omitted names stay unknown. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: AuxiliaryScenarioTests.test_speed_linear_ramp_and_endpoint_hold
functions.description: Interpolate numerical speed and hold the first and last supplied values. Supply 0..100 km/h points at 1..3 seconds. Assert before/after endpoint holds and exact quarter/midpoint linear values at 1.5 and 2 seconds. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: AuxiliaryScenarioTests.test_step_speed_can_move_between_known_and_unknown
functions.description: Apply null speed at the exact step timestamp and recover on a later step. Use speed 10, null and 20 km/h at 0, 1 and 2 seconds. Assert values immediately before each boundary and at the boundary; null must remain explicit. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: AuxiliaryScenarioTests.test_drive_mode_steps_include_unknown_and_all_supported_modes
functions.description: Sample N, D, R and null at exact boundaries without numerical interpolation. Use null/N/D/R points at whole seconds; sample their exact timestamps and a later endpoint. Assert categorical values are held rather than interpolated. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: AuxiliaryScenarioTests.test_every_status_steps_through_all_states
functions.description: Check all seven status names at unknown, ok, fault and recovery boundaries. Reuse an unknown/ok/fault/ok track for all seven statuses. Assert each name at exact steps and just before transitions, covering fault recovery. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: AuxiliaryScenarioTests.test_constant_speed_boundaries
functions.description: Accept the documented synthetic speed bounds and explicit unknown value. Parse speed 0, 65535, 0.25 km/h and null in separate subtests. Assert each is accepted and returned unchanged before host integer rounding. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: AuxiliaryScenarioTests.test_rejects_invalid_constant_types_values_and_unknown_fields
functions.description: Reject typos, booleans, nonfinite numbers and unsupported mode/status values. Feed unsupported object shapes, misspelled names, nonfinite/oversized speed, booleans and invalid mode/status constants; require ValueError for every case. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: AuxiliaryScenarioTests.test_rejects_invalid_track_shapes_times_and_missing_values
functions.description: Require complete, ordered, finite point objects and supported interpolation. Feed empty/malformed points, missing fields, unknown fields, bad modes and negative/nonfinite/duplicate/reversed seconds; each must raise ValueError. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: AuxiliaryScenarioTests.test_rejects_linear_unknown_speed_or_categorical_tracks
functions.description: Permit linear interpolation only when every speed point is numerical. Try null-containing linear speed and linear mode/status tracks. Assert ValueError rather than attempting arithmetic on unknown or categorical values. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: AuxiliaryScenarioTests.test_invalid_categorical_point_values_are_rejected
functions.description: Apply mode and status validation to points as well as constants. Place invalid mode/status values or a missing status value inside point objects; require the same ValueError validation as constant inputs. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: AuxiliaryScenarioTests.test_json_duplicate_fields_are_rejected_at_every_auxiliary_level
functions.description: Detect duplicate auxiliary, input, status and point fields while loading JSON. Write temporary JSON with repeated auxiliary, speed, status and point keys. Loading each file must raise ValueError; the temporary directory is cleaned up. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: AuxiliaryScenarioTests.test_rejects_invalid_sampling_time
functions.description: Reject negative, nonfinite and nonnumerical elapsed times before sampling. Sample auxiliary state using negative seconds, infinity, NaN, bool, string and None. Assert rejection before any track is evaluated. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: AuxiliaryScenarioTests.test_returned_status_mapping_does_not_mutate_the_scenario
functions.description: Return an independent status dictionary for each sample. Change the imd entry in one sampled output dict. Resampling must still return the original ok track, proving output mappings are independent. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: AuxiliaryScenarioTests.test_direct_three_argument_construction_remains_compatible
functions.description: Preserve the previously available duration/tracks/faults constructor. Construct Scenario from parsed duration/tracks/faults without auxiliary tracks. Assert the default factory supplies all seven unknown statuses. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: AuxiliaryScenarioTests.test_existing_battery_sampling_and_faults_are_unchanged
functions.description: Allow synthetic auxiliary state alongside the existing battery API and pause faults. Combine a -10..10 A ramp, 1..2-second pause and speed 20 km/h. Assert current at zero crossing, start-inclusive/end-exclusive fault activation and auxiliary value. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: AuxiliaryScenarioTests.test_dashboard_example_has_speed_modes_status_faults_and_can_recovery
functions.description: Keep the editable dashboard example valid and cover all status states plus CAN faults. Load the checked-in dashboard JSON and compare its names with parsed tracks. Sample its speed/modes/statuses and 2..3-second fault recovery; no bus is opened. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: VirtualFirmwarePipelineTests.setUpClass
functions.description: Compile the replay adapter against production source with address/UB checks. No external inputs. Locate clang/cc, create a temporary executable and compile the production-driver replay adapter with strict warnings and ASan/UBSan. Store class paths for later tests; missing compiler or failed compilation raises.

functions.name: VirtualFirmwarePipelineTests.tearDownClass
functions.description: Remove the test executable after the production driver checks complete. Use the class-owned TemporaryDirectory created by setUpClass; delete its compiler output and return None after all replay tests. No hardware state is reset.

functions.name: VirtualFirmwarePipelineTests.replay_bus
functions.description: Transport each timed frame through python-can, then decode its received bytes in C. Input frames is an ordered list of (tick_ms, Message) pairs. Open two unique same-process endpoints, send/receive each frame and assert receipt, then pass the received metadata/bytes to decode_frames. Return C snapshots; endpoints close on exit.

functions.name: VirtualFirmwarePipelineTests.decode_frames
functions.description: Serialize received frame metadata and clock times into the production-driver adapter. Input frames pairs millisecond ticks with received Messages. Serialize exact ID/flags/hex bytes into the --replay adapter, run it with a ten-second timeout and check its exit status. Return parsed JSON snapshots and require one per input frame.

functions.name: VirtualFirmwarePipelineTests.test_all_ten_virtual_signals_reach_firmware_snapshot
functions.description: Known engineering values must survive transport and the actual C conversions. Send known values for every PID through genuine virtual endpoints and the production C adapter; require updated flags, integer conversions and signed power. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: VirtualFirmwarePipelineTests.test_time_varying_current_retains_real_firmware_statistics
functions.description: A changing CAN current sequence must update C min/max/average and signed power. Replay 400 V and -100/0/200 A samples at increasing millisecond ticks. Assert production C current min/max/mean and -40/80/13 kW power statistics. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: VirtualFirmwarePipelineTests.test_malformed_virtual_frames_preserve_state_and_recover
functions.description: Oversized, wrong-type and wrong-PCI traffic must be rejected without a sanitizer fault. Replay valid voltage, 64-byte FD, extended and segmented-PCI frames, then valid 420 V. Assert rejection preserves 400 V state until recovery; sanitizers stay active. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: VirtualFirmwarePipelineTests.test_json_timeline_and_fault_window_reach_real_driver
functions.description: Request a ramp over virtual CAN and verify that pause/malformed windows do not poison C stats. Use a current ramp with pause at 1 second and short DLC at 2 seconds. Plan requests via virtual CAN, then replay received bytes in C and assert clean recovery and the retained real-driver current/power averages. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: ProtocolTests.test_all_ten_response_encodings
functions.description: Require each implemented PID, service, PCI length and unit conversion. Compare independently specified exact eight-byte hex responses for all ten signal/unit examples; assert 0x7EB ID, standard/classic flags and DLC 8. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: ProtocolTests.test_request_round_trip_and_padding
functions.description: Create the firmware's eight-byte 0x22 requests for every known PID. Iterate every PID, asserting ID 0x7E3, PCI/service/PID prefix and four zero padding bytes; request_signal must return the original name. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: ProtocolTests.test_rejects_invalid_request_shapes
functions.description: Ignore unrelated IDs, services, segmented PCI, unknown PIDs and nonclassic frames. Mutate ID, extended/remote/error/FD flags, service, PCI, PID and lengths. Recognition must return None without reading invalid payload offsets. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: ProtocolTests.test_encodes_boundary_values_without_wrapping
functions.description: Map legitimate extrema to exact wire values, including offset current. Compare extrema against explicit ffff/0000/fffe/c8 payload hex for voltage, current, SOC and cell voltage; valid inputs must retain their intended endpoints. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: ProtocolTests.test_rejects_nonfinite_and_out_of_range_values
functions.description: Stop invalid engineering values instead of silently clamping their input. Pass invalid voltage inputs plus out-of-range current and SOC. Each encoding must raise ValueError instead of clamping or wrapping an invalid engineering value. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: ProtocolTests.test_raw_override_allows_unphysical_wire_extrema
functions.description: Expose raw 65535 current and raw 255 SOC for firmware boundary tests. Force raw current 65535 and SOC 255 and inspect exact bytes. Require ValueError for a raw SOC override of 256, which cannot fit its one-byte payload. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: ScenarioTests.test_linear_interpolation_and_endpoint_hold
functions.description: Ramp current through zero and hold the first/last values outside the points. Sample a -10..10 A ramp between 1 and 3 seconds at 0, 2 and 9 seconds. Assert first hold, midpoint zero and last hold independently of transport. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: ScenarioTests.test_step_changes_at_exact_point_and_preserves_other_defaults
functions.description: Apply step values at their timestamp and supply all unspecified signals. Step SOC from 100 to 0 percent at 2 seconds. Assert old value at 1.999, new value at 2, and a complete ten-signal mapping including omitted defaults. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: ScenarioTests.test_rejects_ambiguous_or_invalid_scenario_configuration
functions.description: Reject typos, unsupported versions, invalid points and invalid fault parameters. Iterate misspelled fields, unsupported version, duration/track faults, bad fault types/intervals/targets and parameter bounds. Require ValueError per input. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: ScenarioTests.test_json_file_loading_rejects_duplicate_fields
functions.description: Read an editable scenario and reject accidental duplicate signal entries. Create a temporary current scenario, verify 12.3 A reads correctly, then add a duplicate signal key and require loading to fail. No transport is opened. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: ScenarioTests.test_checked_in_scenarios_validate_and_cover_every_fault_type
functions.description: Keep the editable examples runnable and include every documented fault control. Read normal.json and edge_cases.json; assert normal has no faults and the edge-case set matches every supported FAULT_PARAMETERS type. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: ScenarioTests.test_fault_intervals_are_start_inclusive_end_exclusive
functions.description: Activate a targeted fault only within its stated interval and signal. Apply a current-only pause from 1 to 2 seconds. Assert active at 1, inactive at 2 and inactive for the untargeted voltage signal. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: ResponderTests.responder
functions.description: Build a one-second fault window with optionally specified signal values. Fault dicts are wrapped in the same start=1/end=2-second interval; optional signals supply engineering inputs, otherwise defaults apply. Return a new Responder with independent loss counters. Invalid fixture data propagates parser errors; no transport.

functions.name: ResponderTests.test_samples_value_at_request_time
functions.description: Encode the interpolated value when a request arrives, even if sending is delayed. Request the current ramp at 1 second with 0.2-second delay. Assert due 1.2 seconds and raw bytes for the sampled 10 A, not the future delivery-time value. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: ResponderTests.test_pause_window_recovers_and_unrelated_requests_are_ignored
functions.description: Drop responses during pause and resume after its end without altering requests. Request before, during and after a 1..2-second pause, then change request ID. Assert one response outside the interval and no response during/for unrelated ID. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: ResponderTests.test_drop_every_second_matching_request
functions.description: Apply the loss cadence only to requests matching the active fault target. Interleave current and voltage requests under a current-only every=2 fault. Assert voltage does not advance the matching-current drop cadence. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: ResponderTests.test_wrong_identifier_service_pci_and_unknown_pid_mutations
functions.description: Produce independently selected malformed response headers. Create each header mutation with explicit hex parameters and inspect the selected ID/byte/PID; expected malformed bytes must be generated exactly. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: ResponderTests.test_short_dlc_truncates_actual_payload
functions.description: Send an actual four-byte frame rather than just lying in its DLC field. Request voltage with DLC 4 fault; assert both Message.dlc and actual data length/header bytes reflect truncation rather than mismatched metadata. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: ResponderTests.test_duplicate_spacing_and_burst_count
functions.description: Schedule extra duplicates with spacing and bounded simultaneous bursts. Plan two extra copies spaced 0.1 seconds at t=1, then a 32-frame burst. Assert due times 1/1.1/1.2 and all burst frames due simultaneously at 1. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: ResponderTests.test_raw_fault_reaches_current_and_soc_wire_boundaries
functions.description: Bypass engineering ranges explicitly for decoder saturation tests. Plan targeted raw-current 65535 and raw-SOC 255 faults. Inspect payload bytes without opening a bus; engineering-range bypass must be explicit. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: VirtualBusTests.setUp
functions.description: Create two genuine python-can virtual endpoints on a unique channel. No external arguments. Allocate a UUID channel and server/client via guarded open_bus; register shutdown cleanups with unittest. Each test receives isolated genuine virtual endpoints, preventing traffic from unrelated test instances.

functions.name: VirtualBusTests.test_all_pids_cross_actual_virtual_bus
functions.description: Round trip ten requests and require response identity and payload. Round-trip the ten requests on unique in-process endpoints; verify ID/PID and the -12.3 A raw bytes, then accepted/sent counters both equal ten. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: VirtualBusTests.test_delay_and_pause_over_bus_with_deterministic_clock
functions.description: Withhold responses before due time and recover from request loss afterward. Advance explicit seconds around 0.2 delay and 1..2 pause boundaries. Assert no early frame, due delivery, pause loss and immediate post-pause response. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: VirtualBusTests.test_duplicate_and_malformed_frames_cross_bus
functions.description: Preserve intentional short DLC and duplicate count over the bus boundary. Combine DLC 3 with two extra copies. Require three actually received short frames and no fourth frame, proving transport preserves intentional malformed data. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: VirtualBusTests.test_pending_queue_limit_stops_unbounded_delayed_bursts
functions.description: Fail explicitly before scheduling more messages than the configured queue limit. Plan four delayed frames into a runner capped at three. Require OverflowError and an empty queue because the request batch is rejected before heap insertion. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: VirtualBusTests.test_rejects_clock_reversal
functions.description: Prevent a scheduler from silently accepting time travel between steps. Step at 2 seconds then at 1. Require ValueError rather than silently moving the scheduler clock backward; no requests are necessary. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: InterfaceSafetyTests.sysfs
functions.description: Build the sysfs evidence fixture used before any SocketCAN bus opens. Root is a temporary directory; channel/virtual/link_type select fixture evidence. Create device directories, type text and class/net symlink, returning the root Path. This writes only a fake tree and never modifies the operating system /sys.

functions.name: InterfaceSafetyTests.link_result
functions.description: Return the kernel link-kind response normally supplied by iproute2. Kind selects the mocked info_kind string; return CompletedProcess with successful JSON stdout for vcan0. No subprocess is launched by this helper; validate_vcan tests patch subprocess.run to inject this result.

functions.name: InterfaceSafetyTests.test_accepts_only_virtual_can_sysfs_and_vcan_kernel_kind
functions.description: Require both the virtual CAN sysfs path and the explicit vcan link kind. Build a virtual sysfs fixture and mock iproute2 reporting info_kind vcan. Validation must return without exception; no actual SocketCAN socket is opened. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: InterfaceSafetyTests.test_rejects_physical_device_named_vcan0
functions.description: Reject a hardware CAN network interface regardless of its misleading name. Build class/net/vcan0 pointing into a simulated PCI device tree. Require ValueError despite its virtual-looking name, without touching a hardware device. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: InterfaceSafetyTests.test_rejects_noncan_virtual_device_and_vxcan
functions.description: Do not infer vcan from a name, virtual sysfs path or CAN device type alone. Reject sysfs type 1 and, separately, kernel kind vxcan with CAN type 280. Independent evidence must agree rather than relying on a name alone. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: InterfaceSafetyTests.test_rejects_missing_kernel_evidence_and_nonlinux
functions.description: Fail closed when sysfs, iproute2 or Linux SocketCAN support is unavailable. Check missing sysfs, mocked missing ip executable and platform darwin. Require ValueError in each case before any SocketCAN endpoint could open. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: InterfaceSafetyTests.test_disallows_other_backends_and_physical_channel_names
functions.description: Block backend selection and channel names that can address physical adapters. Call open_bus for pcan and for socketcan channel can0. Both must raise ValueError before adapter selection or a physical network bind. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: CLITests.test_default_virtual_demo_requests_and_receives
functions.description: Run the in-process demo and verify JSON frame events and a final summary. Launch the standalone virtual --demo CLI for 0.11 simulated seconds at rate 5. Parse stdout JSON lines; require successful exit, an RX event and positive sent count. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: CLITests.test_cli_rejects_physical_bus_before_open
functions.description: Reject physical SocketCAN channels without transmitting or attempting a bind. Launch the CLI requesting socketcan/can0. Require nonzero exit and vcan error text; the configured guard rejects the physical channel before opening a bus. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: DashboardCliTests.run_command
functions.description: Run CLI orchestration against a completed-output boundary and capture its public result. Directory owns temporary artifacts; extra adds CLI flags and browser_result selects launcher success/failure/exception. Mock host build/run and OS browser, capture stdout/stderr, require exit zero and exact preserved JSON bytes. Return (output Path, browser mock, stderr text). No real browser or host process starts.

functions.name: DashboardCliTests.test_open_launches_the_completed_viewer_uri
functions.description: An explicit --open request must launch the completed HTML at a space-safe file URI. Use the mocked completed run with a directory containing spaces and --open. Require exactly one browser call with the resolved file URI and no error output. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: DashboardCliTests.test_default_run_keeps_browser_launch_optional
functions.description: CLI automation without --open must retain its JSON output without a browser side effect. Run the mocked CLI without --open. Assert no browser call and empty stderr; JSON summary and exact scenario-byte preservation are checked by the helper. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: DashboardCliTests.test_failed_browser_launch_preserves_completed_artifacts
functions.description: An unavailable default browser must expose the saved viewer location without losing output. Make webbrowser.open return False for --open. Assert it was attempted once and stderr identifies the saved index.html while successful outputs remain. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: DashboardCliTests.test_browser_error_reports_the_saved_viewer
functions.description: Browser registry or process errors must retain the generated run and give its path. Inject webbrowser.Error and OSError separately. The CLI must return success for completed data and print the saved player path rather than lose the run. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: DashboardSimulationTests.test_host_rejects_invalid_command_without_hardware

functions.name: DashboardSimulationTests.test_host_rejects_overflow_and_malformed_payload_tokens
functions.description: Oversized integers and single-character payloads must not wrap into valid commands. functions.name: DashboardSimulationTests.test_output_cannot_overwrite_input_or_hard_link
functions.description: Artifact paths must reject input aliases before writing any run data. Protect JSON bytes placed at summary.json and then hard-linked to log.bin. Each run must fail with ValueError before writing and preserve the original bytes. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: DashboardSimulationTests.test_invalid_run_bounds_do_not_start_host
functions.description: Bad time/capture settings and excessive step counts fail before subprocess access. Return None on success; unittest assertions or unexpected errors fail this case.

functions.name: DashboardSimulationTests.test_default_captures_follow_inputs_ten_times_per_second

functions.name: FunctionInventoryTests.test_ignores_commented_functions_and_calls_inside_strings

Assert only active definitions/calls appear, and confirm the adjacent real explanation is retained. No fixture code is executed.

functions.name: FunctionInventoryTests.test_finds_pointer_return_and_callback_reference
functions.description: Pointer-returning definitions and registered callback references are inventoried. Parse a pointer-returning definition whose body passes a callback identifier. Assert both real names and the callback reference are recorded; the test does not claim registration executes the callback.

functions.name: FunctionInventoryTests.test_resolves_static_names_in_their_own_file
functions.description: Same-named static helpers must not create a cross-file edge. Combine two C files with identically named static helpers. Assert the caller resolves only to its own file helper, preventing a source graph from inventing cross-file linkage.

functions.name: FunctionInventoryTests.test_missing_comment_is_not_replaced_with_invented_description
functions.description: An undocumented function retains an explicit evidence gap. Parse one uncommented C definition. Assert documented is false and the literal evidence-gap message is preserved; no description is synthesized from its name or body.

functions.name: FunctionInventoryTests.test_nested_python_calls_belong_to_the_nested_function
functions.description: Defining an inner function must not imply that its calls execute in the outer function. Parse an outer function that defines/returns a callback. Assert the outer call set is empty and only the nested function contains target, distinguishing definition from execution.

functions.name: FunctionInventoryTests.test_production_calls_do_not_resolve_to_test_hal_fakes
functions.description: Firmware call relationships must not claim that the host-only HAL runs on the board. Combine a production HAL clock caller with a test-only same-name HAL definition. Assert no edge is emitted, because a test substitute is not the MCU implementation.

functions.name: FunctionInventoryTests.test_production_calls_do_not_resolve_to_dashboard_host_fakes
functions.description: A reusable production source must not imply it always uses the memory-only HAL. Combine production and host clock callers with a host HAL substitute. functions.name: FunctionInventoryTests.test_javascript_nested_scope_and_callbacks
functions.description: Inventory nested named functions and assigned arrows without attributing nested calls to their parent. The fixture passes a callback without executing it. functions.name: FunctionInventoryTests.test_javascript_same_named_helpers_are_lexical

functions.name: FunctionInventoryTests.test_javascript_anonymous_callback_has_location_and_comment

functions.name: FunctionInventoryTests.test_javascript_missing_comment_remains_a_gap

functions.name: FunctionInventoryTests.test_html_script_lines_and_noncode_data

functions.name: FunctionInventoryTests.test_javascript_dynamic_members_remain_unresolved
